title: AEP NL journal mirror integrity verification
scope: Strict JSONL-to-SQLite mirror verification with explicit safe tail synchronization
alternatives: Keep head-only status comparison or make SQLite an authoritative source
impact: Mirror discrepancies become HOLD and cannot be silently repaired by sync
counter_evidence: SQLite is a local derivative and cannot prove distributed durability or replace JSONL authority
acceptance_criteria: Verify checks head, count and event fields; divergence blocks sync; tests pass
rollback_reference: Revert the journal verification commit and retain the existing JSONL-authoritative journal mirror.
